judgment: It is good to ford the great river.
image: Clouds rise up to heaven: Held Up.
So the noble one eats and drinks,
lines: He waits at the edge of town.
It is good to keep constant.
then comes out of the hole.
He waits at wine and food.
He goes down into the hole.
he honours them: in the end, good.

notes.name_en: 需 is need held up as waiting (clouds not yet rain); 'Held Up', not Wilhelm's bare 'Waiting'.
notes.L4: 血/穴: blood and the pit-hole kept as places of waiting, a step worse each line.
